name: english_agreement
description: Select is/are to agree with a singular or plural English subject; control copies the subject from the same sentence.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
nouns=['cat','dog','teacher','student','doctor','artist','bird','robot','flower','tree','car','book','house','cup','window','computer','phone','bottle','chair','table']
adjs=['ready','quiet','small','clean','nearby']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 n=random.choice(nouns); plural=bool(i%2); subject=n+('s' if plural else ''); adj=random.choice(adjs)
 s=f'The {subject} ___ {adj}.'
 items.append({'prompt':f'Complete the sentence with is or are.\n{s}\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+('are' if plural else 'is')})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Copy the noun that is the subject.\n{s}\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+subject})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
